description: Buy-it-for-me: sends an Assisted Purchase request to the Global Shopaholics team, for when the user wants something from a US store (including stores that refuse foreign cards or addresses) shipped to them. GS checks price/availability, confirms the total with the customer by email, buys from the US store, and ships it. Nothing is charged by this tool and no payment happens in chat; GS emails an invoice. Legal items only. Only call after the user has confirmed product link(s), quantity, destination, name and email. Returns a reference id and next steps.

budget_usd.description: Max the customer wants to spend on items.

product_urls.description: Product page URL(s) at US stores (http or https).

name: request_assisted_purchase
title: Buy from any US store for the user, delivered abroad (assisted purchase / personal shopper)
